text:
Peregrine Lens has acquired Fennimore Optics, the company announced on 14 March 2031.

Delphine Okonkwo-Hale, Peregrine Lens's Chief Executive Officer, confirmed the deal. The transaction is valued at $412 million in cash and stock.

This account rests on two documents this reporter has read: a joint press release from the two companies, and a regulatory filing submitted to the Halvern Trade Commission, Filing No. HTC-31-0227. Both describe the acquisition as complete and name Peregrine Lens as the buyer.

Fennimore Optics, a familiar name to many Baywater readers, will now operate under Peregrine Lens ownership. The documents I reviewed do not set out further terms, and I have not reported anything beyond what they state.

The Gazette will report additional details as they are made public.
